provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Lun’tharavé is centered at -70.777906, 16.816239 under Participatory Democracy, with 35,306,000 people across 10 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Lun’tharavé occupies 3,690,965.16 sq mi / 9,559,555.87 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 1.874181% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Beach and grass with water, Farming and Partial forest define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Farming, Beach and grass with water and Beach and reefs with water. Population density is 3.693 people/sq km / 9.566 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Dwarven and Gnomish Kin, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin, Harengon, Centaur, Giff, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Choral Synod, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Bastveig, Sokhivar, Sigrananna, Marduthor, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 11 recorded four-province geography group links, including 8 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Grond of the Milk-Oath
npcs.description:
Grond of the Milk-Oath is a blunt, towering Goliath warrior who mistakes poetry for literal instruction and believes “kindness” must be some hidden strength mortals drink, train, or beat into themselves. As one of Anubaldir’s giantkin, they value endurance, shared burden, direct conflict, and visible strength, but their travels slowly teach them that people survive through loyalty, settlement bonds, and fighting for those weaker than themselves.
At the Settlement Training Yard, Grond serves the Crucible Wardens as a siege companion and brutal defensive instructor, teaching recruits how to hold gates, break charges, and stop panicking when larger monsters hit the wall. They are loud, literal, battle-hungry, and often alarming, but their growing fascination with “the milk of mercy” makes them unexpectedly protective of civilians, chosen family, and any settlement that proves strength means standing together.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Sylmaris is a City in Lun’tharavé, under Participatory Democracy, with low danger, Beach and grass with water, Farming, Partial forest terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Goliath reads through the Goliath entry of the race compendium, within Giantkin and Powerful Humanoids, marked by Anubaldir. Goliaths are mountain-dwelling giantkin known for endurance and physical prowess. They view life as a series of challenges to overcome through strength and perseverance. Table cues: Giant Ancestry, Large Form, Powerful Build; starting tendency Neutral - Neutral - Neutral - Honorable.
rumors: Grond of the Milk-Oath knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Valkhaday.
Grond of the Milk-Oath has a contact in Aelmoryth who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Grond of the Milk-Oath asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
A rival faction offers proof that Grond of the Milk-Oath's public story is incomplete.
